root_cause.text: In do_task_stat(), the code dereferences task->real_parent without RCU protection, then passes the pointer to task_tgid_nr_ns() which takes RCU read lock too late, allowing a use-after-free when the parent task is freed concurrently.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message illustrate the race: cpu0 reads task->real_parent, then cpu1 releases the parent and schedules RCU callback, then cpu0 uses the now-freed pointer inside task_tgid_nr_ns() despite its internal rcu_read_lock(). The patch uses task_ppid_nr_ns() instead, which internally acquires RCU protection before accessing the parent.

intent_record.how: The new call uses a dedicated helper that correctly resolves the parent PID in the given pid namespace, handling edge cases such as namespace isolation or parent thread group leadership.

bic_trace_step.reason: The commit moves the assignment of ppid (which dereferences task->real_parent) from before lock_task_sighand() to inside the locked section, while the rcu_read_lock() remains taken before that section. This ensures that the access to task->real_parent occurs under RCU protection, eliminating the use-after-free vulnerability. The diff clearly shows this fix, and the removal of the vulnerable construct is evident.
